about: As case 214, plus the gallery rail line, a tagged line in the same piece that nothing in the record or findings names. The could_not entry no longer hides every line of its story note from the lines the run did nothing with: the rail line is listed under Other notes, and stays off the handled list with the roof line. The swim line and its copy go on.
spec: plan-run-manager.md Milestone 17, first checkbox, item 5 ('but another tagged line of the same story note that nothing names now is')
readings: log.json can't check that a string is missing from a section, so this case doesn't check that the roof line is left out of Other notes; case 214 checks that.
